clue.text: English essayist suitable for graduate study

parts.note: BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a graduate
to con is to study or pore over

explanation.surface: An English essayist is judged fit material for postgraduate study.
explanation.walkthrough: Francis Bacon was the Elizabethan writer of the Essays; 'suitable for' is only link.
explanation.definitionFit: Francis Bacon, philosopher and statesman, is famous for his Essays.

clue.text: Business generated by a fine exhibition

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencil leads
a fair is a show or exhibition

explanation.surface: Trade is drummed up by a splendid show.
explanation.definitionFit: An affair is a matter or concern, as in 'that is my business'.

clue.text: Recommend a barrister

definitions.meaning: to speak in favour of or urge something
a lawyer who pleads a case in court

explanation.definitionFit: To advocate is to back a course of action; an advocate is a pleading lawyer, especially in Scotland.

clue.text: Given a rocket for being last in bed

indicators.note: the word last is set within the word bed, like a sleeper lying in it

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone is scolded for being the final one still lying in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Given a rocket' is British slang for being sharply told off, the same as being blasted.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are slang for a severe reprimand: to be torn into verbally.

clue.text: Unofficial request to put a novice in the picture

parts.note: to put someone in the picture is to inform them
L, the learner plate, stands for a novice

explanation.surface: A casual request to brief a newcomer on what is going on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put ... in the picture' is the phrase meaning tell; 'a novice' (A and L, as on British learner plates) sits within it in the surface but follows it in the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something informal is casual, without official sanction.

clue.text: Blowouts may cause it, but if a blowout occurs you'll need it

definitions.meaning: a blowout is a huge meal, and too many give a roll of fat round the waist

definitions.text: if a blowout occurs you'll need it
definitions.meaning: a blowout is also a burst tyre, needing the reserve wheel from the boot

explanation.definitionFit: A spare tyre is both a bulge of belly fat and the extra wheel carried for punctures.

clue.text: To impose excessive strain on a violin constitutes evasion of duty

parts.note: to tax is to strain or overburden
fiddle is the informal word for a violin

explanation.surface: Overworking a violin is a dereliction of musical duty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'duty' looks like obligation, but here it is a tax owed, and a fiddle is a swindle.
explanation.definitionFit: A tax fiddle is a dodge to avoid paying what is owed to the revenue.

clue.text: Have a shot at getting a bird

definitions.meaning: to fire from cover, or attack with sly criticism
a long-billed wading bird

explanation.definitionFit: To snipe is to shoot from hiding; the snipe is a marsh wader once hunted as game.

clue.text: Is unable to produce pious platitudes

definitions.meaning: contraction of cannot
hypocritical sanctimonious talk

explanation.definitionFit: Can't means cannot; cant is insincere moralising talk.

clue.text: They may add flavour to meat so minced

indicators.note: meat that is minced is chopped up, so these letters are chopped and reassembled

explanation.surface: Some ingredient may season meat that has been ground up.
explanation.definitionFit: Tomatoes are a common addition to a meat sauce for taste.

clue.text: A table of food on ship

parts.note: board is an old word for a table spread with meals, as in bed and board

explanation.surface: A spread of food laid out on a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Aboard means on or in a ship or other vehicle.

clue.text: Region about to be taken in by a motoring organisation

indicators.note: the word for about is absorbed inside the organisation's initials

parts.note: the AA is the Automobile Association, a British motoring breakdown body
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A district is about to be covered by a breakdown service.
explanation.definitionFit: An area is a district or zone.

clue.text: I'm in an Eastern country to make an appraisal

indicators.note: I'm is placed inside the word for country

parts.note: a state is a nation or country
taken as written without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: Someone in an Eastern land sets out to make an assessment.
explanation.definitionFit: To estimate is to judge or value something approximately.

clue.text: The top of a skyscraper is some thing incredible

definitions.meaning: a high upper floor of a very tall building, with story as the American spelling of storey
an exaggerated, unbelievable tale

explanation.definitionFit: A tall story is a far-fetched yarn; punningly, a skyscraper's upper floor is a tall storey.

clue.text: Game introduced into Britain by Lord Elgin

definitions.meaning: a children's game played with small glass balls

definitions.text: introduced into Britain by Lord Elgin
definitions.meaning: Lord Elgin brought sculptures from the Parthenon to Britain

explanation.definitionFit: Marbles is a playground game; the Elgin Marbles are Parthenon sculptures in the British Museum.

clue.text: The players got on getting dressed

parts.note: a band is a group of musicians playing together
to get on is to grow old, so got on means aged

explanation.surface: The musicians grew older while changing into their costumes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dressed' here means having a wound covered, not putting on clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: A wound that is dressed has been bound up with a covering strip.

clue.text: Blunders could have caused their cries

definitions.meaning: glaring, laughable mistakes
those who wail or yowl, such as wolves or monkeys, utter loud cries

explanation.definitionFit: Howlers are silly mistakes; literally they are creatures that yowl.

clue.text: Cast not great, but it's going to be a hit

definitions.text: it's going to be a hit

indicators.note: cast as in casting metal, the letters are thrown into a new mould

explanation.surface: The actors are not much good, but the show will be a success.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cast' suggests actors, but it signals the letters are reshaped.
explanation.definitionFit: An aim on target will strike home.

clue.text: Tramples down a child

definitions.meaning: treads heavily on something
a spouse's offspring from an earlier relationship

explanation.definitionFit: Steps on means treads on or crushes; a stepson is a partner's son by an earlier marriage.

clue.text: The whole thing is chaotic from dusk to dawn

parts.note: all means the whole or entirety

indicators.note: being in chaos, the word thing is thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Everything is a mess, all through the hours of darkness.
explanation.definitionFit: All night means throughout the hours of darkness.

clue.text: He is in Information Technology initially

parts.note: gen is British slang for information

indicators.note: initially picks out the opening letter of the word Technology

explanation.surface: A man works in IT, at least at the start.
explanation.definitionFit: A gent is a gentleman, a man, so male pronoun stands for him.

clue.text: Count and recount

definitions.meaning: as a bank teller counts money
to narrate or relate a story

explanation.definitionFit: To tell can mean to count, as in telling votes, and to narrate.

clue.text: More off from class

parts.note: less is the opposite of more
on is the opposite of off

explanation.surface: Someone is set free from school sooner.
explanation.walkthrough: Each piece is replaced by its opposite: more becomes LESS and off becomes ON.
explanation.definitionFit: A lesson is a period of teaching, a class.

clue.text: It can be played softly

definitions.meaning: a keyboard instrument
the musical direction meaning quietly

explanation.definitionFit: A piano is a keyboard instrument, and piano in music means quietly.

clue.text: Sunday exercise requires great effort

parts.note: to train is to exercise or work out

explanation.surface: Working out on the day of rest takes real exertion.
explanation.definitionFit: A strain is an intense exertion or stress.

clue.text: The ship's left reportedly for a city on the Canal

parts.note: port is the left-hand side of a ship
said means reported or alleged

explanation.surface: Word is the vessel has departed for a canal city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left' suggests departure, but it is the side of the ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Port Said is the Egyptian city at the northern end of the Suez Canal.

clue.text: The window of an Oxford college

definitions.meaning: a bay window projecting from an upper storey
one of the colleges of Oxford University

explanation.definitionFit: An oriel is a projecting upper bay window; Oriel College is in Oxford.

clue.text: Call made to those showing ill humour

definitions.meaning: to visit, drop in on someone

definitions.text: made to those showing ill humour
definitions.meaning: the urging to sulkers to recover their good temper

explanation.definitionFit: To come round is to pay a visit, and also to get over a sulk.
